blocks.orig: The Lake Manyara Kilimamoja Lodge lies on an escarpment at the edge of Lake Manyara National Park, where it boasts astonishing views over the park. On days with clear skies, you can even see Mounts Meru and Kilimanjaro from this lodge. All rooms are luxuriously and comfortably appointed, with for example an outside & inside shower, a fireplace, free WiFi and a private balcony with a panoramic view. The main building has a spa, a TV room, a giant swimming pool and a spot where at night a fire is lit so you can watch the vast sky full of stars.
blocks.html: Perched on an escarpment on the edge of Lake Manyara National Park, The Lake Manyara Kilimamoja Lodge has remarkable views across the park. When the sky is clear, you can even make out Mounts Meru and Kilimanjaro from the lodge. Every room is furnished in a luxurious, comfortable way, including features such as an outdoor & indoor shower, a fireplace, free WiFi and a private balcony with panoramic views. In the main building you will find a spa, a TV room, a huge swimming pool and a place where a fire is lit in the evening, so you can gaze up at the vast, star-filled sky.
